subject: Next steps: buyer sponsorship + security/ procurement contacts
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medivex.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@medivex.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + two asks from today

Lena — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. High level recap so we have the same next steps:  

- Outcome: Medivex is evaluating a pilot for 3 clinical teams to reduce latency and cost on chart summarization and Q&A.
- Product fit: Redwood Dedicated looks like the right model (data isolation + predictable throughput). We discussed SLA needs and basic security controls.

Two quick asks to help us progress the commercial and security threads:  
1) Can you share the minimal stakeholder list/org sketch (PDF or bullet list) that shows who owns budget (economic buyer), procurement, legal, and the security/compliance owner? If you prefer, a short screenshot of org chart or an internal alias list is great.
2) Can you confirm the decision criteria and timeline you expect for moving a pilot to procurement? For example: proof of concept in Jan, security review in Feb, PO in Mar — anything like that helps us align.

If easier, a 20–30m internal connect with whoever owns procurement or security would be ideal — we can walk them through the SOC2/architecture pack and be light on time.

I copied Marissa (AE) and Aditya (SE) so they can follow up on commercial cadence and compile the security artifacts.

Next steps from our side: we will assemble a short security packet (SOC2 summary, data flow diagram, retention policy) and a pricing indicator worksheet for a 3-team pilot.

Thanks again — available to hop on a call this week if you want to run through names.

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-pricing-indicator.csv (stub)
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medivex.com>

Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + two asks from today

Karthik — great walkthrough earlier. Thanks. I attached a rough org sketch (internal use) and captured the owners below:  

- Economic buyer / Budget owner: Priya Anand, SVP Finance (priya.anand@medivex.com)
- Primary sponsor / product lead: Lena Ortiz, Dir Clinical Ops (me)
- Security/compliance owner: Marcus Lin, Head of InfoSec (marcus.lin@medivex.com)
- Procurement contact: procurement@medivex.com (team inbox) — main contact: Tom Hsu, Senior Procurement Manager

Decision criteria / expected timeline:  
- Technical pilot sign-off (POC) — Jan 2028 (2–4 weeks pilot)
- Security review — parallel in Jan/Feb (Marcus will do an initial checklist then deeper review)
- Procurement paperwork / PO — targeted by end of Feb / early Mar, contingent on security OK and budget sign-off.

I attached: Medivex_org_sketch.pdf (very approximate).

Can we get a short (15–20m) session next Tuesday or Wednesday to introduce Marcus and Tom to your security and procurement materials? Tom prefers mornings.

Also — one data point: Priya will want a preliminary ballpark number before committing time; a range is fine (not a formal quote).

Thanks,
Lena
Lena Ortiz
Director, Clinical Operations | Medivex Health

Marissa / Aditya — forwarding Lena's reply and org sketch. Short ask: can each of you own the following so we can move quickly?

- Marissa (AE): Own the commercial intro with Priya (SVP Finance). Prepare a ballpark for a 3-team pilot (monthly run-rate + estimated one-time onboarding). I put a HubSpot placeholder for the deal: MDV-2027-0452. Can you propose two time slots for a quick intro with Priya and Tom Hsu? Tom prefers mornings (PST).

- Aditya (SE): Pull together the short security pack: SOC2 snapshot, network/data flow diagram, retention and deletion controls, and answers to the common procurement checklist. Also prepare a short FAQ for Marcus about encryption/keys and data residency. If you already have a condensed one-pager, send it to Lena and Marcus before the intro call.

I'll coordinate scheduling and be present on the calls. Lena — if you can share Marcus's calendar window or suggest two slots next Tue/Wed morning that work for Tom and Marcus, we'll lock it.

Thanks — low-friction approach here; we want to be helpful and not flood them with docs up-front.

—
